name: Observed regime
additional_information_or_assumption: Valid randomized/comparative design and measurement under observed regime r_A
what_becomes_defensible: Treatment effect on the observed AI-assisted outcome

name: Rank transport
additional_information_or_assumption: Pairwise sign preservation of direct active-arm contrasts across regimes; a common increasing mapping is one sufficient stronger model.
what_becomes_defensible: Intervention ordering can be transported for the specified pairs.
boundary: Sign preservation is additional cross-regime structure; magnitude remains unidentified without a quantitative mapping.

name: Quantitative transport
additional_information_or_assumption: Known or identified mapping/structural model with transportability assumptions
what_becomes_defensible: Quantitative extrapolation of independent-regime treatment effects

name: Learning/retention/transfer interpretation
additional_information_or_assumption: Independent assessment plus appropriate delay, overlap, transfer, measurement validity, and credible AI non-use evidence
what_becomes_defensible: Bounded learning/retention/transfer claim for sampled tasks/population
boundary: Still limited by outcome validity, sampling, scoring, and causal design.
